Welcome to Yorkshire Vet Official!

This channel features episodes and highlights from The Yorkshire Vet, a factual documentary series following the work of experienced veterinarians across the British countryside. 

The series stars Julian Norton, Peter Wright, Matt Smith, and Jeanette Appleton, as they care for farm animals and pets while supporting traditional farming communities.

From routine visits to challenging medical cases, the channel offers an honest and human look at veterinary medicine, countryside living, and the bond between animals and the people who look after them.

Perfect for viewers who enjoy real-life documentaries, animal-focused stories, rural lifestyles, and unscripted factual television.
